campaign.title: Gateway to Networking 2026
campaign.subtitle: Free self-paced Cisco NetAcad courses for aspiring network professionals.

courses.title: Networking Basics
courses.description: Build a foundation in networking concepts, devices, connectivity and how networks operate.
courses.overview: An introductory starting point for learners who want to understand how computer networks connect devices and support communication.
topics: How networks support everyday digital services
courses.for: Beginners exploring networking for the first time.
outcomes: Explain network types, data transmission, bandwidth and throughput.
Identify network components, clients, servers, ISP connectivity and wireless/mobile connections.
Describe Ethernet, IPv4, routing, TCP/UDP and application-layer services.
Build a simple LAN and use network testing utilities.
courses.durationNote: Cisco's published CCST Networking curriculum lists 22 hours for this course; Cisco identifies it as available instructor-led or self-paced.

courses.title: Network Addressing and Basic Troubleshooting
courses.description: Explore network addressing concepts and foundational troubleshooting techniques.
courses.overview: A foundation-level course focused on network addressing concepts and the first steps in diagnosing common connectivity issues.
courses.for: Learners who want to strengthen their IP addressing and basic troubleshooting foundations.
outcomes: Explain physical-layer, data-link and network-layer functions in network communication.
Implement an IPv6 addressing scheme.
Describe the operation of Cisco routers and switches.
Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues.
courses.durationNote: Cisco's published CCST Networking curriculum lists 14 hours for this course; Cisco identifies it as available instructor-led or self-paced.

courses.title: Network Support and Security
courses.description: Discover network support practices and essential security principles.
courses.overview: An introduction to the support practices and security considerations involved in maintaining network environments.
courses.for: Learners interested in network operations, technical support and security fundamentals.
outcomes: Apply troubleshooting methodologies and help-desk best practices.
Explain common endpoint threats, vulnerabilities and attacks.
Describe essential steps to configure secure user access on a network.
courses.durationNote: Cisco's published CCST Networking curriculum lists 12 hours for this course; Cisco identifies it as available instructor-led or self-paced.

courses.title: Network Defense
courses.description: Learn core concepts and practices used to defend networks against threats.
courses.overview: An introduction to the concepts and practices used to protect network environments from security threats.
courses.for: Learners interested in cybersecurity and protecting network infrastructure.
outcomes: Explain defense-in-depth and system/network defense principles.
Apply access-control concepts and configure access control lists in learning scenarios.
Describe firewall technologies, cloud security and cryptography.
Understand network security data and evaluate security alerts.
courses.durationNote: Cisco's current Network Defense course page lists 27 hours and labels this version instructor-led. A separate self-paced duration is not stated here.

courses.title: Networking Essentials
courses.description: Develop practical understanding of networking essentials and common technologies.
courses.overview: A broader introduction to networking technologies and the skills used to understand and work with networked systems.
courses.for: Learners who want a structured introduction to networking essentials.
outcomes: Explain how end-user devices and local networks interact with the global Internet.
Explain network connectivity requirements and the role of IP addressing.
Build a small network using an integrated router.
Explain TCP/IP protocols and configure wireless router security.
Troubleshoot common home and small-business network issues.
courses.durationNote: Cisco's course catalog lists a 65-hour instructor-led course. This is not presented as a self-paced duration.

courses.title: Network Security
courses.description: Understand the foundations of securing networks, systems and information.
courses.overview: An introduction to the principles and practices involved in securing networked systems and information.
topics: Building security awareness for network environments
courses.for: Learners looking to explore network security as part of an IT or cybersecurity pathway.
courses.duration: Not verified for this exact course listing
outcomes: Understand core network security concepts and the importance of protecting data and devices.
Explore common network threats and security infrastructure.
Review secure network communication and protection principles.
Use the official course page to confirm the current curriculum and assessment details.
courses.durationNote: Cisco's available Network Security material varies by curriculum and delivery. No duration is displayed here until the exact self-paced course version can be confirmed.
